subject: Exception condition handling
notes: w70c (kb/Work PB1117 landed). cite.py --check 14.6.13.2 'The EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE exception condition is set to exist for a class condition and a VALIDATE statement when invalid data is detected during item identification' -> OK 14.6.13.2 1). The first half (a boolean sending item's own content) was already conforming (pb230). The second sentence now holds: every NUMERIC position operand - a subscript, a reference-modification position, and every codegen-time count (OCCURS DEPENDING object, RECORD VARYING DEPENDING, report DEPENDING) - reads through its own profile, CobolTable.Occ(x, in NumProfile) / CobolString.RefModPosition(x, in NumProfile), whose character-image arm is CobolNum.ParseImageSending, the checked rule-2 read; the class-condition exemption covers the tested item, never its subscript (NOTE 1). Measured on the w70c build: IF TE(N) IS ALPHABETIC with N holding 'A' under checking -> RAISED EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE (golden leg 2); pre-fix the tolerant DigitMagnitude scan raised nothing. VALIDATE is A.4.14 Not claimed (PB283), so its item-identification leg is vacuous. || editions: 2002, 2014, 2023 (>>TURN is refused at 85, COBOL0900)
